diagnosis: The application relies on a flawed Prisma $use middleware that only injects tenant boundaries when params.action === 'findMany'. The route handler queries tax returns using prisma.taxReturn.findUnique({ where: { id: req.params.returnId } }), which is completely ignored by the middleware. Furthermore, Prisma findUnique rejects non-unique filter fields like tenantId unless a composite unique key exists, allowing any user to read other citizens' confidential tax returns and SSNs by ID.
